data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Michael LaFramboise and John Marmaduke, having raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 companies: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private frontier-tech firms in the same sector, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, implying a $25M valuation. The Peer-Median method examines 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence, UFORCE, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI), which span a range of $125M to $4.0B with a median valuation of $1.0B. This approach implies $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide implied range: low of $21M, median of $512M, and high of $1.1B. The dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation multiples in an emergent frontier-tech sector where peer valuations vary by 32x. The Stage-Progression result anchors to funding precedent; the Peer-Median method is sensitive to whether comparables truly reflect risk-adjusted market consensus for early-stage defense-tech ventures. Further diligence on revenue trajectory and technical differentiation relative to named peers would be required to narrow this range meaningfully.
